description: dryvist/.github master Renovate preset — the single source of truth for Renovate policy across ALL dryvist AND JacobPEvans repos. This is the MASTER: it extends no other repository’s config. JacobPEvans/.github extends THIS (github>dryvist/.github:renovate-presets), never the reverse. Consumers extend it via local>dryvist/.github (the default preset, which extends this) or directly via github>dryvist/.github:renovate-presets.

Architecture: this file holds global policy (auto-merge, trusted orgs, stability features, custom managers). Ecosystem grouping rules live in renovate-grouping.json and are pulled in via extends below. Inline description fields on each rule are the canonical documentation — keep them current.

WARNING: platformAutomerge MUST stay false. GitHub’s auto-merge queue has a known bug where PRs pass all checks but GitHub never executes the merge — PRs stall for days with no error. With false, Renovate merges directly via API with built-in retry logic. Do NOT set this to true.

Tiered freshness model (canonical: SECURITY.md → Dependency Trust, and docs.jacobpevans.com/infrastructure/cicd/dependency-automation). The top-level `schedule` sets the DEFAULT cadence to WEEKLY — this is the untrusted long-tail tier. First-party (own-org) overrides to `at any time` for immediate propagation. Trusted orgs override to TWICE-WEEKLY (Mon/Thu): minor/patch auto-merge after a 3-day stabilization; MAJORS open a review PR and never auto-merge (a trusted publisher is not proof of a compatible API). Security/CVE fixes bypass the schedule entirely via vulnerabilityAlerts (`at any time`, 0-day, auto-merge). Non-trusted majors stay held 30 days. The untrusted long-tail is additionally reviewed by the dryvist/ai-workflows dependency reviewer, which auto-merges only the risk:low subset.

customManagers.description: Renovate-annotated version pins in Nix files. HASH FIELDS ARE NOT UPDATED — only version strings. Each repo's fix-renovate-hashes.yml runs nix-update to fix adjacent hash = "sha256-..." fields after Renovate bumps a version. When adding a new fetchPypi/fetchurl package with a Renovate annotation, also add it to that repo's nix-update workflow and flake packages output.

description: Docker images pinned in Ansible role defaults as `<name>_image: "repo:tag"`. These live in plain YAML vars that no built-in Renovate manager scans, so image pins across ansible-proxmox-apps roles (prometheus_stack, netmon, qdrant_docker, ntfy_docker, mailpit_docker, unifi_metrics, seerr, ...) were untracked. Matched as the `docker` datasource so Renovate bumps the tag in place; image refs are self-describing (repo:tag) so no per-line `# renovate:` annotation is needed. Untagged refs (no colon) are not matched; local-only tags resolve to nothing and are skipped.

customManagers.description: Renovate-annotated version pins in Ansible role defaults (YAML). Mirrors the .nix annotation manager but for roles/**/defaults/main.yml — binary version vars (e.g. traefik_version, object_storage_rustfs_version) interpolated into download URLs that no built-in manager scans. Only lines carrying an explicit `# renovate:` annotation are matched. Release checksums are fetched at install time (no hash field to update here), so unlike the .nix manager no companion hash-fixer workflow is needed.

packageRules.description: Disable all updates in gh-aw generated files — managed by gh-aw-pin-refresh workflow, not Renovate

Tag major updates with an additive `update:major` label (minor/patch are inferred by its absence). Gives the dryvist/ai-workflows dependency reviewer a deterministic, AI-independent 'is this a major?' gate so majors never auto-merge, and lets humans filter. addLabels is additive: it does not disturb scheduling, auto-merge, or the dep:review label.

Major-version default, org-wide: hold non-trusted-vendor majors 30 days before a PR opens, and never auto-merge (human review required). The grace gives upstream ecosystems time to surface breaking-change regressions before we adopt them. Rules below are placed AFTER this one so their values win per-attribute (Renovate merges packageRule attributes by last-match wins): own-org restores immediate auto-merge for JacobPEvans/** and dryvist/** majors; the trusted-orgs MAJOR rule shortens the hold to 3 days and opens a review PR (still no auto-merge — a trusted publisher is not proof of a compatible API); the trusted-orgs minor/patch rule auto-merges those (3-day stabilization, twice-weekly). Non-trusted-vendor majors match only this rule and stay held 30 days. CVE-driven bumps bypass the grace entirely via the top-level vulnerabilityAlerts block (0 days, any time).

Auto-merge own-org dependencies (JacobPEvans / JacobPEvans-personal + dryvist) — immediate, all ecosystems, all update types including major. Placed AFTER the major-default rule so we restore immediate auto-merge for our own majors that the major-default rule would otherwise hold for 30 days. Also overrides the top-level weekly `schedule` with `at any time` so first-party changes propagate on merge, not on the weekly window — release-please cuts + auto-merges the release, and consumers pick it up here at 0-day. JacobPEvans-personal is the renamed legacy personal account (dryvist/JacobPEvans account split); JacobPEvans/** still resolves via redirect but the current owner is listed explicitly.

Pin external GitHub Action refs to a full commit SHA (supply-chain hardening). Replaces the invalid top-level `pinGitHubActionDigests` key with Renovate's canonical per-manager `pinDigests`. Scoped to the `github-actions` manager, so it pins both `uses:` action refs AND any container/service images referenced in workflow jobs — a deliberate superset of the `helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests` preset (which only covers `uses:`). First-party refs (dryvist / JacobPEvans / JacobPEvans-personal) are exempted by the rule immediately below (Renovate is last-match-wins per attribute).

First-party reusable workflows (dryvist / JacobPEvans / JacobPEvans-personal — the same owners the own-org rule above treats as first-party) ride @main and must NEVER be digest-pinned. They are self-owned; @main is the deliberate self-reference convention (SECURITY.md → Version Pinning). Without this, Renovate rewrites `uses: <first-party>/...@main` to a SHA and auto-merges it (own-org rule above), silently breaking the convention across every consumer. Mirrors the zizmor `dryvist/*: ref-pin` allowance; CodeQL code scanning is managed as IaC in tofu-github, not here. Untrusted/external actions are unaffected — they keep SHA digests.

Auto-merge trusted orgs — MINOR/PATCH only, twice-weekly (Mon/Thu), after a 3-day stabilization. Placed AFTER the major-default rule (Renovate last-match-wins per attribute). Trusted MAJORS are handled by the separate trusted-major rule immediately below (review PR, no auto-merge); non-trusted majors hit only major-default (30-day hold, no auto-merge). `matchPackageNames` matches the resolved `packageName` (`owner/repo` for GitHub Actions and Nix flake `github:` inputs); the old `https://github.com/...` URL form was removed as it never matched (verified via `gh search code 'depName=https://github.com/' org:JacobPEvans`, zero results). ECOSYSTEM NOTE: `owner/**` does NOT match npm/PyPI/Terraform packages published by that org (their packageName is the bare package, e.g. `boto3`), so those currently fall through to the untrusted tier — safe, they get AI review. Promote specific ecosystems to trusted with `matchSourceUrls` carve-outs (see the HuggingFace rule below); a full per-ecosystem audit is a tracked follow-up.

Trusted-org MAJOR updates: shorten the major-default 30-day hold to 3 days and open a review PR, but do NOT auto-merge — a trusted publisher is not proof of a compatible API (breaking majors can pass shallow CI yet break runtime behavior, infra convergence, provider schemas, or CLI flags). Same curated allowlist as the minor/patch rule above. Labelled dep:review so humans can find them; twice-weekly (Mon/Thu) visibility. Non-trusted majors are unaffected and stay in the 30-day hold.
Auto-merge trusted PyPI packages from HuggingFace (minor/patch only)
GitHub releases use v-prefixed tags for custom Nix packages
Twice-weekly schedule for all custom regex managers

Auto-merge Python minor/patch updates across every Python manager. Paired with the major-only `>=` bump rule below; the two share an identical manager list so behavior is symmetric: minor/patch auto-merge twice-weekly, major opens a PR (held by the 30-day major-default rule and reviewed manually). pip_setup/poetry/pipenv were added to match the bump rule's coverage — previously only pep621/pip_requirements auto-merged, an unintentional gap.
